title: Construct the full paid robust one-species baseline
statement: Choose no catalysts and the rational coefficients/time/tolerance in the contract. Under fixed relative errors e_b,e_d in[-delta,delta], immigration rate beta=c lambda(1+e_b),death a=c(1+e_d),theta=beta/a. Exact transient law is independent Bin(n0,q)+Pois(theta(1-q)),q=exp(-aT), from particle lifetimes and thinned immigration. Births have finite rate and deaths remove existing particles, giving nonexplosion. Bounds a>=c/2,theta<=3lambda,|theta-lambda|<=4lambda delta<=epsilon/4,q<=1/(1+aT)<=epsilon/(8A0) yield both transient TV toPois(theta) and absolute mean difference<=(n0+theta)q<=epsilon/8. Poisson-addition coupling toPois(lambda) separately pays TV and mean bias; no TV-to-unbounded-mean inference. Expected ACTUAL firings=integral(beta+aE X(t))dt<=n0+2beta T<=n0+3T. Thus stationary and transient TV/absolute-mean errors<epsilon, time/firings<=C W^3,tolerance/coefficient inverses<=C W^2 and compiler complete-binary resources polynomial. This is one-species robust construction, not the general-network theorem.
